input.description: A value of the form {"$handle": "hdl_..."} is a reference to a second input handle.

mode.description: A limit on the place of execution. auto: where the resource of the target handle is. local: only in the runtime process. remote: only on a remote worker.

strategy.description: Applies to capabilities that return a handle. lazy: record the computation, do not run it. eager: run it now and store the output.

async.description: true: the runtime does all checks, puts the operation in the job queue, and returns a job handle with the status running.
